page.overview:
What is Cloudcraft?

The cloudcraft was a small space transport.

Governor Bisad Koong of Roon's Tawntoom province owned a cloudcraft during the early years of the Galactic Empire. In 15 BBY, the vessel came into the possession of Mungo Baobab, who used it while searching Roon for the source of the Roonstones.
